enchantments.text: Lesser Absorption of Beholder and Doomsphere Spells - 20 Charges, No Recharges
enchantments.tooltip: Lesser Absorption of Beholder and Doomsphere Spells: This effect absorbs the most deadly of the standard spells from beholder and doomsphere eye beams. A charge is expended for each eye beam absorbed.
